'''Barabi''' was a made-up [[Planet/Legends|planet]], supposedly in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] once lied about smuggling [[Spice/Legends|spice]] on Barabi to his friends on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]].<ref name="RFR" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[Jason Fry]], co-author of ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', indicated in [[March]] [[2023]] that Barabi was excluded from [[Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion|''The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion]] because it was an imaginary location.<ref name="Email">{{EmailCite|email=File:EAOC discussion 2023.jpg|creator=Jason Fry|date=2023-03-25}}</ref>
